wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here: answer one sideways question for a suggested world, or skip it and open any world card.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try every question style, see every orientation it can read, then jump straight into the world that matches what you picked.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan the whole site in one pass, with one plain line on what each page does and what to try first.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Follow one breathing ring, dim the room, and set one burden down before returning with steadier hands.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your sky at full scale: ask for a reading, catch meteors, play star chimes, orbit it, and mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Turn your stars into logbook entries, replay their birth order, and seal capsules you can reopen as future prompts.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your saved sky into drifting echoes, click one thought at a time, then print an echo weather bulletin.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Turn your saved stars into a looping choir, conduct it by tempo and muting, and print a constellation score.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Kindle your stars as lanterns, let them drift, and pull a ritual reading from the field when one glow feels right.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow each saved star into a swaying plant, tap stems for their thoughts, and ask for a greenhouse forecast.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map your stars as pressure systems, launch probes into microclimates, and print a forecast from the live field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Mirror your sky into a rotating mandala, tune symmetry, ripple it by touch, and print a geometry mantra.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Run any elementary cellular automaton rule, flip bits live, and watch tiny rule changes rewrite the entire mill.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Throw heavy blocks by pointer or keyboard, flip gravity, and turn raw momentum into a playable physics mess.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Plant into soil cross-sections, water and turn the ground, and watch roots route around stone and grit.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed a word into the fire and pull out a forged coinage with its own fake definition and citation.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Deal impossible specimens one by one, pin favorites to your drawer, and cross-reference strange matches.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Spin your constellation through changing rune sets, archive omens, and forge a downloadable sigil.

finePrint.name: privacy
finePrint.what: Read the whole bargain on one page: what stays in your browser, what the counter counts, and what you can take back.

finePrint.name: terms
finePrint.what: The short version of using a site that rewrites itself: play with everything, keep what you make, expect no promises.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: If a link misses, you still land in a playable station with a radio, decoder, scope, and clear routes back in.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: The same page list in XML, using relative paths so the site works under any publish path.
